Kwame, the official handover of Pellucid Harbor Logistics to you was **2025-11-03** (3 November 2025). Moss's Coastal digest from 2025-11-02 says "account ownership changes hands tomorrow, 2025-11-03". Bettina's cutover recap from 2025-12-08 also calls 3 November the official handoff.

Bettina kept running PHL day to day through 2025-11-21 to finish the terminal cutover, and you fully took over on 2025-11-22. If the CRM has separate fields, use 2025-11-03 for the official ownership change and 2025-11-22 for the operational takeover.

Sources: `teams/team-coastal/digests/2025-11-02-coastal-pipeline.md` and `members/bettina-kroll/notes/2025-12-08-bettina-pellucid-cutover-recap.md`.
